claim: Historical high accuracy (78-88%) was an artifact of scan-level data leakage across training and test splits.
caveat: Applies strictly to scan-level splitting without participant grouping.
recommended_use_in_paper: Essential to cite in Introduction and Related Work to debunk prior methodological flaws.

claim: Non-ridge scanner platen border brightness significantly correlated with self-reported blood group (F=5.996, p=0.0006).
caveat: Correlation resulted from temporal session batch collection, not biological causation.
recommended_use_in_paper: Highlight in Methodology as the rationale for shifting to segmented, background-masked ridge representations.

claim: Increasing spatial input resolution from 112x112 to 224x224 did not improve participant classification (p=0.6225).
caveat: Balanced accuracy dropped from 28.61% to 26.15% under fixed 80-epoch training.
recommended_use_in_paper: Include in Ablation Studies to demonstrate that downsampling was not the bottleneck.

claim: Handcrafted dermatoglyphic minutiae features yielded 35.0% accuracy, falling within the permutation null distribution (p=0.2537).
caveat: Legacy script initially reported 28.75% fold-local baseline; corrected to global 36.25% in audit.
recommended_use_in_paper: Cite as empirical evidence that macroscopic minutiae counts do not distinguish ABO blood groups.

claim: Continuous spatial ridge-orientation tensors (920-d) achieved 40.0% accuracy, statistically non-significant (p=0.1089).
caveat: Permutation test used 100 iterations on the post-hoc selected best model; null distribution reached 35.5% balanced acc.
recommended_use_in_paper: Report as the primary ridge-orientation experiment, noting that balanced accuracy remained within chance.

claim: Intra-participant scan quality is uniform (95% ratio < 1.5), and quality-weighting performs equal to or worse than unweighted averaging.
caveat: Simple averaging provides a 42% noise reduction variance filter (1/sqrt(3)).
recommended_use_in_paper: Cite in multi-instance fusion section to justify simple multi-scan pooling over complex weighting.

claim: All late-stage participant-level models achieved 0.0% recall on minority class AB+ (0/7 participants).
caveat: Severe class imbalance (AB+ represents only 8.75% of participants: 7 out of 80).
recommended_use_in_paper: Crucial limitation to report; proves models collapse to majority classes and lack 4-class discrimination.

claim: Development cohort blood group labels are self-reported student survey responses without serological validation.
caveat: Estimated 5-10% self-reporting error rate places an empirical noise ceiling on model learning.
recommended_use_in_paper: Must be stated explicitly in Dataset Limitations section of the paper.

claim: The operational Flask web backend enforces mandatory research consent and assigns pseudonymous participant identifiers (P-xxxx).
caveat: Registration endpoint rejects session creation if consent_given is False.
recommended_use_in_paper: Include in Software Architecture section as evidence of research ethics compliance.

claim: The multi-scan inference engine requires exactly three left-thumb impressions before computing predictions.
caveat: Premature inference requests (< 3 scans) or excess captures (> 3 scans) return HTTP 400.
recommended_use_in_paper: Describe in Data Collection and User Interface section.

claim: Mantra MFS100 optical scanner operates at 500 DPI with a 16x24 mm sensor surface capturing 312x512 8-bit grayscale images.
caveat: Mock mode simulates 312x512 images when physical hardware or Windows SDK is unavailable.

claim: The operational SQLite database data/blood_group.db stores predictions, research captures, and research sessions with zero freelist fragmentation.
caveat: File size is 0.20 MB across 51 pages; 0 freelist pages exist.
recommended_use_in_paper: Cite in Data Management & Provenance section.

claim: The project removed a verified bit-for-bit duplicate checkpoint epoch_22.keras while preserving canonical resnet50_mfs100_abo_v1_1.keras.
caveat: Both files shared SHA-256 45680aeb...; canonical model verified loadable via tf.keras.models.load_model.
recommended_use_in_paper: Cite in Model Lineage and Repository Governance documentation.

claim: Out-of-domain evaluation on the locked Test-21 cohort resulted in accuracy collapse to 33.33%, falling below majority baseline (36.25%).
caveat: Demonstrates severe out-of-domain degradation due to scanner background drift.
recommended_use_in_paper: Report in External Validation section as evidence that CNN features do not generalize.

claim: C5 preprocessing pipeline applies alpha compositing on white background, foreground cropping, contrast enhancement, and target resizing.
caveat: Input shape resized to 112x112x3 for baseline models and 224x224x3 in EXP-07.
